description.narrative:
Georgia plans to conduct a general Population Census together with an agricultural census in 2024. The preparation of the census is a priority in the National Strategy for the Development of Official Statistics in Georgia 2020-2023. The data obtained from the Census will provide critical data and information necessary to improve evidence-based planning and monitoring of the progress of the country development.
The Census 2024 will be conducted by National Statistics Office of Georgia (GeoStat). Based on its mandate, the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) provides technical assistance for conducting Population Censuses all over the world and will support GeoStat in this case as well.
The contribution will be implemented by UNFPA as the Agreement Partner, while the beneficiary of the Swedish support and the implementing agency of the census is GeoStat.
The overall objective of the contribution is to contribute to improved availability of population statistics data in Georgia for evidence-based policy-making, programme planning and monitoring in order to achieve Georgia's development priorities, including the national Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and targets.
The specific objectives of the contribution are defined as follows:
a) Geostat's operational capacity is strengthened to apply modern methodologies in Census undertaking;
This is the first Census in Georgia, when Geostat plans to apply the Computer Assisted Personal Interviews (CAPI) method. CAPI is a face-to-face data collection method in which the interviewer uses a tablet to record answers given during the interview. Technical specifications of tablets have already been prepared by Geostat. In 2023, using state funds allocated for Census preparations, Geostat has procured around 8,000 tablets through state procurement system. The Sida contribution will be used to fill the gap and procure the remaining 2,000 (/- 200) tablets, assuring that the full amount of tablets are available no later than April, 2024.
b) Geostat technical capacity is enhanced for undertaking quality Census;
Achieving of this specific result will help to enhance the capacity of participants in various aspects of census management and census-taking; to understand and articulate the importance of effective dissemination of census data as an integral part of conducting a census in compliance with the Conference of European Statisticians recommendations.

Projektet syftar till att bidra till en förbättrad tillgång till tillförlitliga statistiska uppgifter i Georgien genom att stärka Geostats tekniska och operativa kapacitet att genomföra en allmän folkräkning av hög kvalitet under 2024 och öka befolkningens medvetenhet om folkräkningens betydelse.

The Project aims to contribute to improved availability of reliable statistical data in Georgia through strengthening Geostat’s technical and operational capacities to undertake the quality General Population Census-2024 and increasing population awareness on the importance of Census.
